# SBAI Immobilier (SBAI Abdelhai & Associés)

> Real-estate developer in Tangier, Morocco, since 1969. Residences by the sea and in the hills of Tangier: Triple Towers, Del Costa, Del Costa 2, Les Villas de la Colline. Site in French and Arabic.

## Projects
- [Triple Towers](https://www.sbai-abdelhai.com/fr/projets/triple-towers): three towers facing the bay of Tangier
- [Del Costa 2](https://www.sbai-abdelhai.com/fr/projets/del-costa-2): new seaside residence, launch 2026
- [Del Costa](https://www.sbai-abdelhai.com/fr/projets/del-costa): delivered seaside residence
- [Les Villas de la Colline](https://www.sbai-abdelhai.com/fr/projets/les-villas-de-la-colline): villas with gardens overlooking the bay
- [All projects](https://www.sbai-abdelhai.com/fr/projets)

## Company
- [Our history](https://www.sbai-abdelhai.com/fr/notre-histoire): founded in 1969 by Abdelhai Sbai
